name: wx
description: Service-aware git workflow helper for multi-service repositories

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show working-tree changes grouped by service

commands.name: service
commands.description: List or manage registered services in wx.json

commands.name: affected
commands.description: Print services touched relative to a base branch

options.description: Base branch to diff against (default: main)

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Create a scoped conventional commit, interactively

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show a diff, optionally scoped to a service

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a bun script inside a service's directory

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Fetch and fast-forward the current branch

commands.name: rebase
commands.description: Rebase the current branch onto a base branch

commands.name: push
commands.description: Push the current branch to origin

commands.name: pr
commands.description: Open or create a pull/merge request for the current branch

examples: wx commit api -m "fix: handle null user"
